name: cargo-bay-open-a
refs: Our signed Incubator stage (project-owned): the housing's materials, sage moulded frame, warm dark interior, matte light from the top left. Match this family exactly.
Our signed small cargo bay, open (project-owned): the one look of the bay, a sage moulded case with a dark interior. The big bay is this same object, seen from the front, much wider.
Our signed sealed crate (project-owned), for scale only: three of these will stand side by side on the bay floor later. Do NOT paint any crate.
prompt: Paint the INTERIOR of a wide, shallow cargo bay seen straight from the front, filling the whole picture edge to edge, about three times wider than tall. A thin sage moulded rim frames all four edges (very thin, like the Incubator stage's frame but slimmer). Inside: a plain warm dark back wall in the upper two thirds, softly lit from the top left, then a flat matte sage moulded floor shelf across the full width in the lower third, seen slightly from above, with a plain narrow front lip along the bottom. The floor is empty and even, with three equal, evenly spaced, slightly worn standing places, no markings needed. Keep everything quiet and low in detail so crates stand out on it: no gauges, no hoses, no props, no crates, no boxes, no lamps, no lights, no glow, no text, no numbers, no people. Matte painterly rendering exactly as the references, same palette.
